customers_say: Customers find the water purifier exceeds expectations in performance and design, with smooth installation and no issues reported. The water quality receives positive feedback, with one customer noting TDS levels below 100, and they appreciate its appearance, with one highlighting the modern touch panel with LED indicators. They like the taste and service, with one mentioning no service needed for 2 years. However, reliability is a concern as multiple customers report units stopping within one month of use.

reviews.author: om rakshak
reviews.title: Good Product, but High Output TDS and Disappointing After-Sales Service
reviews.body: The product is good overall, but the main issue with my particular purifier is the TDS. My input water TDS is around 550, but the purifier’s output TDS is still going up to 190–200. I believe this may be an issue with my particular unit, as I’ve seen many other reviews where users are getting around 60 TDS with similar input water. Unfortunately, the bigger disappointment has been the after-sales service. I tried contacting Urban Company multiple times, but the service team did not respond properly. reviews.author: Amazon Customer
reviews.title: Excellent RO with Great Service and Professional Installation
reviews.body: I’m very happy with my Native M2 Pro RO. The installation service was excellent, and the technician was polite, professional, and explained everything clearly. The RO looks premium, works smoothly, and the water quality is very good. Overall, a great experience and good value for money. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: mohammed ghiya
reviews.title: Excellent water purifier with premium features
reviews.body: I recently purchased the Native M2 Pro from Amazon and overall I’m very satisfied with the product. The design looks premium and modern, and the touch controls make dispensing water very convenient. The water purification performance has been excellent so far, and the water tastes clean and fresh. I particularly like the smart features and the Urban Company app, where you can monitor the purifier, filter status and water usage. The installation experience was also smooth.

reviews.author: Dinesh
reviews.title: Value for money and quality of water is good.
reviews.body: Product delivery took some time, but installation took place on the second day, installation process was smooth, technician done a wonderful job. Found continuous leakage from the tank after installation, same was fixed the next day by technician. Purifier is very silent, easy to setup with wifi and to connect with phone. Quality of water is good and very tasty, tds level came down to around 40-50 ppm. Got inbuilt battery just to dispense water incase of power cut, purifier doesn't run with that battery.
